detail.title: Operational Criteria for Physical Causal Memory
detail.summary: Physical causal memory is operationally valid when internal states enable predictive control over future dynamics. Recent findings demonstrate that this causal influence is bounded by thermodynamic uncertainty relations and dissipation limits.
detail.reason: Notebook updated to integrate thermodynamic uncertainty bounds and statistical limitations on causal inference.
